# xg2g raw transport to audio elementary stream corpus, format version 1
#
# Generated. To change it, edit audioTSCorpusCases() in
# backend/internal/stream/ingest/mediafacts/audiots_corpus_test.go and run
#   go test ./internal/stream/ingest/mediafacts/ -run TestAudioTSCorpus -update-audio-ts-corpus
#
# A case is raw MPEG-TS and the elementary stream feeds an audio observer
# must be given for it:
#
#   program <n>     the programme the core is constructed to follow
#   chunk <hex>     one ingest of these bytes, at the offset the previous ones reached
#   target <n>      one change of the programme being followed
#   feed inc= pid= es= <observation>
#                   one feed, in the order it happened, with the observation
#                   that followed it. inc counts stream incarnations in the
#                   order their first feed appears - the same PID before and
#                   after a programme identity change is two streams.
#   stream pid= codec= feeds= <observation>
#                   one stream still being followed when the case ends
#
# Feed boundaries are part of the case. An observer carries a partial frame
# header across a call and skips payload that ran past the end of one, so the
# same bytes joined differently are a different input.
#
# Where an ingest call begins and ends is not. A case cut into other chunks
# has to produce the same feeds, which is a test of its own rather than a
# line in this file.
#
# A case carrying `diverges` is one where the reference does something else,
# and its `ref-feed` and `ref-stream` lines are what the reference does. The
# `feed` lines stay the authored answer: they are what the syntax says, and
# the difference is recorded rather than adopted.
version 1

case ac3_start_then_continuations
  desc one AC-3 PES packet across four transport packets
  program 1
  chunk 
  chunk 
  feed inc=0 pid=0100  channels=0 lfe=0 acmod=0 hasAcmod=0 dependent=0 frames=1
  feed inc=0 pid=0100  channels=0 lfe=0 acmod=0 hasAcmod=0 dependent=0 frames=2
  feed inc=0 pid=0100  channels=2 lfe=0 acmod=2 hasAcmod=1 dependent=0 frames=3
  feed inc=0 pid=0100  channels=2 lfe=0 acmod=2 hasAcmod=1 dependent=0 frames=4
  stream pid=0100 codec=ac3 feeds=4 channels=2 lfe=0 acmod=2 hasAcmod=1 dependent=0 frames=4
end
